issue.body:
Can timeout and scheduling changes recover complete positive control pairs without repairing tasks? Follow-up to #28. Investigation remains open.

**Validated existing exports:** four Matchms tasks and four OHIF tasks now have positive nop/oracle control pairs with clean oracle commands. For OHIF, all eight controls completed at the original 300-second verifier limit; all 40 task files are unchanged and both sides preserve their tracked regression tests. These are controls of existing exports, not eight new tasks. [Matchms results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/188091eb/experiments/29-runtime-limits/matchms-control-results.json) · [OHIF results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/a090c9ce/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-control-results.json).

**Other comparisons:** OpenMS's original 60-second checkout timed out again, while a 300-second arm completed the same commit in 77.9 seconds; this establishes acquisition recovery only. Scanpy's 16 recorded bootstrap actions replayed without command repairs, but smoke/fresh checks failed. Its unchanged PR4389 controls at 300 versus 1,200 verifier seconds are still running. [OpenMS evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/875eab80/experiments/29-runtime-limits/openms-checkout-readback-001.json).

**Next:** read back Scanpy controls, remove its retained image after verified controls, and assess MMseqs2's bootstrap allowance if a separate model budget is recorded. Twelve terminal jobs used 2.96062 allocated CPU-hours; active Scanpy controls reserve at most 9.66667 more under the 32-hour ceiling. Zero model calls or new capacity in this issue. OHIF control/archive readback and owner-labeled image cleanup are verified; only the Scanpy image remains. [OHIF cleanup](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/ab887268/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-recorded-cleanup-readback-001.json). No pipeline promoted. Detailed logs remain in comments.

comment.body: 🤖 The OHIF reconstruction image cleanup completed after all four positive pairs and archive readback. The 858-byte cleanup archive was verified (SHA256 `3d0d545f53003c23ea9dedcfa42dd1e58e47be280aa96394aaf4b6e05ab98d96`). The job checked the exact retained tag/image ID and ownership, then removed owner-labeled images in dependency order; no owner-labeled image or container remains, and the tools were removed. It used 0.01397 allocated CPU-hours, bringing twelve terminal #29 jobs to 2.96062. The separate Scanpy controls remain active, with their image retained until verified readback. [Cleanup proof](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/ab887268/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-recorded-cleanup-readback-001.json).
